content: रवः [रु-अप्] .²1 A cry, shriek, scream, yell, roar (of animals <ab>&c.</ab>); नरवरो रवरोषितकेसरी <ls>R.</ls>; रवः श्रवणभैरवः <ls>Ve. 3. 4</ls>. .²2 Singing, humming sound (of birds); <ls>R. 9. 29</ls>. .²3 Clamour. .²4 Noise or sound in general; घण्टा˚, भूषण˚, चाप˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²5 Thunder.
